scope: Bind same-capture NTFS directory/table primary name-order observations to held ordinary Windows files and the existing owned reader with exact retained-byte parent replay. No public view,full collation,case policy,alias resolution,lookup,physical/elevated source or storage/release authority. Original all-platform/storage0.1.0 remains the goal.
rules: Append NameOrder4 to NtfsSnapshotKind, preserving Bootstrap0,Directory1,Membership2,Upcase3. Add capture_ntfs_name_order_file_owned/testing(NtfsDirectoryFileRequest,stop[,TestControl]) through existing ntfs_file.h/.cpp. Extend existing ntfs_snapshot/ntfs_worker and private probes. Use an explicit private source-mode discriminator for this joint view rather than permitting ambiguous exclusive Upcase/directory booleans. No new production file/directory,opener,host,scheduler,parser or public command. Existing inspection validation must still reject the new private kind.

Reuse the existing ordinary-local-one-link/no-reparse/no-UNC/no-device source policy, pinned parent generations, read-only source handle and exclusion of concurrent write/delete/rename. Copy source/profile/limits/stop/test controls and directory controls before source access or hooks. Validate source/window/global/directory controls before opening, and optional expected_source before content reads. Bind actual metadata,source digest,process PID/creation and per-process capture sequence; retain before/after/final metadata,profile,source consistency and replay separately. No physical source,administrator access,customer data or storage effects.

The same source-owning Observer must acquire directory and actual table through observe_ntfs_name_order. Never combine independently captured directory/table reports. Keep selected-allocation alias checks, every original byte/region, profile/version gates, read/retained/output quotas and diagnostic precedence. Name-order facts remain necessary primary ordering and non-resolving groups; namespace/collation/target-membership/alias-resolution/lookup claims stay false and host case_policy stays unobserved.

NameOrder follows the existing graph/prefix automatic3.0 flow. A3.1 probe stops at observed version mismatch before directory/table acquisition. Validate the natural retained3.0 bootstrap prefix, compare the normalized foundation, and reuse its exact bytes in the continued3.0 observation. No duplicate native prefix reads,guessed profile,host table or retry source. Include name_order in both normalized foundation owners when present,alongside existing directory/table facts; absence leaves every old-mode hash representation unchanged. Explicit profiles and automatic3.1 retain current semantics.

Private org.disked.ntfs-name-order-source-request/1 has exactly the existing base schema,path,expected_source,volume_offset,volume_bytes,profile,limits,fixture fields plus directory_reference and directory_limits. It has no target_limit; C++ input.target_limit must remain64. Reference0 discovers reserved root FILE5 sequence; otherwise require a nonzero high16 sequence. Directory limits remain entries1..4096,blocks1..128,bitmap_bytes1..65536. Reject unsupported or irrelevant controls before source access rather than ignoring them. Normal compositions reject test controls; fault-only fixture handling remains compiled in distinct variants.

Use org.disked.ntfs-name-order-file-capture/1, domain.provider ntfs-name-order-file-prototype and org.disked.ntfs-name-order-region-frame/1. The domain contains exact directory_reference/directory_limits and no target_limit,along with original source/window/profile/global-budget/process/sequence bindings. The nested observation is org.disked.ntfs-name-order-observation-prototype/1. Context image_profile is ordinary-file-ntfs-name-order. Root/file/frame field sets retain the existing strict envelope. Common publication/input/reply envelopes stay v1 because sealed request/frame hashes bind the new schema/kind and exact compiled child.

Native source coherence and aggregate applicability remain distinct. Preserve the current observed_stable formula: validated bindings,metadata/replay/profile agreement,selected profile and observation.applicable. A completed ntfs_name_order_mapped_descent finding therefore has complete=true,reread_equal=true,applicable=false,observed_stable=false while independent native consistency fields can be true. Do not relabel this stable or incomplete,or discard its complete audit/table. Authentic partial,unsupported,quota,source-changed or explicit-version mismatch observations remain inspectable nonapplicable snapshots where existing lifecycle/replay rules allow; no future source/effect authority follows.

Parent verification uses retained responses only and never reopens the live source. Recompute source metadata,attempt budgets,automatic probe prefix/boundary,foundation hashes,selected observation,table bytes/digests,full directory/name-order arrays,counters/groups/flags,domain and receipt counts. Match every request,source/profile/epoch/process/context relationship and exact response byte/provenance ordering. Reject unknown fields/schema,missing or coherently forged mode facts,changed names/groups/contexts/table or claimed flags when retained responses disagree. A self-hashed/schema-valid child assertion alone admits no snapshot.

Prepare opens no source; release starts existing contained capture. Seal path/window/profile/global and directory controls,expected source and capture epoch before launch. Require validated publication,owned child PID/creation/code identity and actual exit before snapshot construction. Preserve immutable result/context/optional frame after worker teardown. Keep launch/startup/late/zero-wait/cancel/retirement/job/source-slot handling and deadlines unchanged; cancellation and timeout are not quiescence.

Extend only existing fault seams: name_order_changed and name_order_directory_changed apply only to NameOrder; existing upcase_changed also applies to NameOrder because its actual table is present. Keep exact fixture-kind validation and normal/fault binary isolation. Preserve existing generic provenance/profile fault scopes. These are test-only targeted forgeries,not producer permissions. Preserve original entry-wait timings and raw output retention before assertions. Do not enlarge a deadline or weaken expected results to make a fixture pass.

Retain input128KiB,payload8MiB,observation2MiB including binding diagnostics,receipt64KiB,job128MiB and existing waits/native quotas. The existing kind-independent retained-frame bound7020544 stays below8MiB. W103 name-order data stays inside its1MiB observation quota; never drop keys/table bytes or increase bounds for a fixture. Refuse oversized input/observation/receipt/frame before publication/verification.

Keep public command schemas,registry,frontend projection and source-free startup behavior unchanged. Existing positive Upcase inspection validation and unknown99 rejection remain. Add explicit private NameOrder4 product-validation rejection. Native file/worker qualification is not public view admission,full collation,host policy,alias resolution,lookup,physical-media qualification or completion of original all-platform/storage0.1.0.
qualification: Before native evaluation define independent generated source/read/region/table/order/group expectations,profile and consistency outcomes. Cover both3.0/3.1 and auto/explicit profiles,above4GiB source windows,supported32768-byte FILEs,empty/siblings/deep trees,nonstandard/non-idempotent tables,case ties and repeated/sequence-distinct references,all namespace codes,fragmented MFT/table and list/bitmap forms,selected-allocation aliases and primary mapped descents. Reconstruct every audit order/comparison/group from original fixture bytes and compare native results with the independent supplied-reader oracle. Exercise each native read/replay/binding/metadata/prefix boundary,short/error/throw/changed responses,source/parent rebinding,missing/denied/reparse/device/UNC/hardlink paths,invalid controls before source access,mutation of original request/hooks and source preservation. Forge every mode-specific scalar/array/context/hash relationship,including coherently rehashed child payloads,without changing retained responses; parent must reject. Exercise actual worker launch,exit,publication-before-exit,late/hang/cancel/retire/zero-wait/resource/source-slot behavior under original deadlines. Preserve raw outputs/traces before assertions and label unavailable host prerequisites. Run exact clean-source all-target pinned x64 build and the entire current native suite after shared native changes,all68 standalone headers,strict C90,fourteen executable import observations,full tooling/generated/context/manifest/source-map checks. Run same-source isolated Win32/WOW64 file/worker/name-order/table/reader regressions,twelve headers and nine executable observations; not full Win32 product or historical/other-host qualification. Preserve and diagnose every failure before a fresh campaign; later passes do not explain older intermittent availability failures.
